movie_title: Your Tattoo is INSIDE Your Immune System. Literally
introduction: Go to https://brilliant.org/nutshell/ to dive deeper into these topics and more with a free 30-day t
lead_intro: Ever wondered what happens inside your skin when you get a tattoo? Dive into the fascinating world of your immune system's battle when ink meets skin!

quiz.question: How many dead skin cells do you shed every hour?
quiz.explanation: The video mentions that every hour, you shed around 200,000,000 dead skin cells.

quiz.question: What is the main job of your immune system when it encounters foreign substances?
choices: Identify and smash it until it's dead
Ignore it and let it stay
quiz.answer: Identify and smash it until it's dead
quiz.explanation: The immune system's main job is to identify what is not you and smash it until it's dead.

quiz.question: What happens to the ink particles when the Macrophages try to dissolve them?
choices: Ink particles don't react in any way
quiz.answer: Ink particles don't react in any way
quiz.explanation: The Macrophages try to dissolve the ink particles by showering them in acid, but the particles don't react in any way.

quiz.question: What causes the tattoo ink to spread around your body over time?
quiz.explanation: As your Macrophages get old and die, some ink can escape, riding fluids flowing from your tissue and spreading around your body.

quiz.question: What happens when you remove a tattoo with lasers?
choices: Ink particles break into smaller chunks
quiz.answer: Ink particles break into smaller chunks
quiz.explanation: When tattoos are removed with lasers, the ink particles are heated up until they break into smaller chunks, eventually carried away by fluids.
